extension.summary: Optional helper for KarmaMole's Kodi skins: art colours, soft art, album spines, grey prints, queue reordering, a genre wheel and Continue / New lists.
extension.description: An optional helper for KarmaMole's Kodi skins. Each skin turns on only the features it uses, and every skin works fully without it. The features: the colours of the focused and the playing album's art, with a soft, blurred copy of the art to light the screen; a coloured spine for every album in the music library; reordering of the Up next queue; the library's genres, styles and moods with album counts, ready to play as a shuffled mix; black-and-white copies of film, show and album art, built in the background and never while a video plays; ready-made lists of what you are watching (the next episode of every show in progress, and films in progress) and of what is new in the library. While a skin that uses none of them is active, the helper stays idle. Colours, soft art, spines and grey prints use the Python Imaging Library (script.module.pil), which Kodi installs with it.
extension.disclaimer: Made for KarmaMole's Kodi skins. Other skins can opt in; see the API notes in the source repository.
extension.news: 1.1.0 - For the Vernissage skin: grey prints (a Day and an Evening black-and-white copy of each film, set, show and album picture, built in the background and updated after library scans, never while a video plays) and two lists, Still on the easel (the next episode of each show in progress, plus films in progress) and New in the collection. Nothing changes for Groove. 1.0.0 - First release as the shared KarmaMole Skin Helper (it was the Groove helper): art colours with soft art, album spines, Up next reordering, genre/style/mood wheel and true shuffle, each turned on per skin. Shuffled mixes are put in a random order by the helper, so Kodi's own shuffle setting is never changed.
